title: Valid Anagram
question: How do you check if two strings are valid anagrams in Java? Give both O(n log n) and O(n) approaches.
realWorldScenario: O(n log n): sort both strings and compare. O(n): frequency count array or HashMap.

title: Group Anagrams
question: How do you group a list of strings into groups of anagrams in Java?
realWorldScenario: Sort each string as a key in a HashMap<String, List<String>> to group anagrams together.

title: Valid Palindrome (with non-alphanumerics)
question: How do you check if a string is a palindrome ignoring non-alphanumeric characters and case?
searchIntent: valid palindrome java interview ignoring special characters
realWorldScenario: Use Character.isLetterOrDigit() to skip non-alphanumeric chars while doing two-pointer comparison.

title: Valid Palindrome II — One Deletion
question: How do you determine if a string can become a palindrome by deleting at most one character?
realWorldScenario: When two-pointers find a mismatch, try deleting left or right character and check if the remainder is a palindrome.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring — Expand Around Center
question: Describe the expand-around-center approach for finding the longest palindromic substring.
realWorldScenario: For each center (n centers for odd, n-1 for even length), expand outward while characters match — O(n²) time O(1) space.

title: Find All Anagrams in String
question: How do you find all starting indices of anagram substrings of pattern p in string s?
searchIntent: find all anagrams in string java interview
realWorldScenario: Sliding window of size p.length() with frequency map comparison — add right char, remove leftmost char.

title: Palindrome Number
question: How do you check if an integer is a palindrome in Java without converting it to a String?
realWorldScenario: Reverse half the number and compare with the other half — negative numbers and numbers ending in 0 are not palindromes.

title: Permutation in String
question: How do you check if one string's permutation is a substring of another (LeetCode 567)?
realWorldScenario: Sliding window of fixed size s1.length() comparing frequency arrays — O(n) after initial setup.
